audit.why: EVEN / 6/10 fits 49.57% over 462 games. Gnar wins the first two levels on range, the middle of the lane is a Rage coinflip, and Tahm Kench reclaims the duel at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the page's own whys — whys[1] describes a Gnar level-2 chunk (stored Skill), whys[2] says the lane 'levels back to even' (stored Tahm Kench), whys[3] says you only win with Rage banked (stored Tahm Kench), whys[5] literally says 'coinflip' (stored Tahm Kench), and the level-6 row was stored Gnar off a false premise.
audit.why: The mirror already placed GNAR! at 6 and made Devour conditional on three stacks; neither champion owns level 6. Real spikes: Gnar levels 1-2, Rage-dependent 3 through first item, Tahm Kench at two items on Thick Skin storage plus lifesteal.
audit.corrected: win[1]=Gnar, win[2..5]=Skill with matching phases sides (phases[6] already Tahm Kench), whys[4] and phases[5].why rewritten. One atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) whys[4], spikes[2], mid and wants.foe[2] all say his level-6 ultimate 'reliably roams bot/mid for a pick'. Devour does not move anyone anywhere — it swallows a champion for a few seconds for magic damage, or shields an ally. There is no ferry in his kit. (b) Thick Skin is treated as passive-only 'grey health he walks off'; the active converts all stored damage into a shield on a 3-second cooldown, which is what actually eats your Mega burst. (c) Nothing states that both the Q stun AND Devour are gated behind three An Acquired Taste stacks.
audit.why: The roam claim is the dangerous one: it tells the player to ping a roam that will never happen and to concede level 6 for a fabricated reason. The stack gate is the real counterplay — refuse the third stack and he has neither a stun nor an ultimate.
audit.corrected: Tongue Lash (Q, 900 range, 7s at rank 1) slows, heals him, and stuns only on the third An Acquired Taste stack, consuming them. Abyssal Dive (W, 21s at rank 1) is the knockup — both sides carry displacement, so whoever lands it first owns the trade. Thick Skin (E, 3s) stores a share of damage taken, heals it out of combat, or converts it to a shield on demand: force it out before you commit. Devour (R) needs three stacks and is a swallow, not a teleport.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that the page carries no cooldown-sequencing advice at all — sequencingCues is 0.
audit.why: Every 'track his Q' line was numberless, so there was nothing to actually count.
audit.corrected: Added 7s Tongue Lash, 21s Abyssal Dive, 3s Thick Skin and the three-stack gate into dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, early and mid.

edits.before: His spike, not yours: your GNAR! ult needs Mega form you can't summon on demand, while his R reliably roams bot/mid — ping the second he's missing and shove the wave he abandons.

edits.before: Mini's ranged autos and Boomerang give you the better level 1 and a strong level 2 — land a few autos into his Hyper third-hit proc plus a Q and you out-poke him before his grey-health passive matters. The catch: a chunk of every hit banks as grey health he regenerates by simply walking out of range, so don't overvalue the chip or chase it. Respect his Q tongue: at 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste it stuns, and if it lands while you're in squishy Mini form with the Rage Bar empty, his jungler can collapse and you have no Mega bulk or Hop reset to escape with.
edits.after: Mini's ranged autos and Boomerang give you the better level 1 and a strong level 2 — a few autos into the Hyper third-hit proc plus a Q out-poke him before Thick Skin (E) matters. The catch: a share of every hit is stored by Thick Skin, healed back once he leaves combat, or converted straight into a shield on its 3-second cooldown, so don't overvalue the chip or chase it. Respect Tongue Lash (Q, 900 range, 7s at rank 1): on the third An Acquired Taste stack it stuns, and eating that in empty-Rage Mini is how his jungler kills you.

edits.before: This stretch is pure Rage RNG. If the bar fills you can Mega-Wallop stun and chain autos for damage that actually out-paces his grey-health regen — that is your only window that sticks. Stuck in Mini with the bar empty when he steps up, his Q stun and bulk let him flip the trade and you're a fragile ranged target with no commit tool. At 6 the spike is his, not yours: GNAR! only exists in Mega form, which you can't reliably summon, so your ult is absent while his R lets him roam — ping his disappearance and punish the wave he gives up rather than forcing a fight you can't finish.
edits.after: This stretch is pure Rage RNG. If the bar fills you can Mega-Wallop stun and chain autos for damage that actually out-paces his Thick Skin healing — that is your only window that sticks. Stuck in Mini with the bar empty when he steps up, Tongue Lash on its third stack stuns and his bulk flips the trade. At 6 neither of you is reliable: GNAR! only exists in Mega form, and Devour needs three An Acquired Taste stacks before he can swallow you — so count his stacks, back off at two, and remember Thick Skin turns everything you chipped into a shield on a 3-second cooldown.

notes: Fabrication removed: four fields claimed Tahm Kench's level-6 ultimate 'reliably roams bot/mid for a pick'. Devour swallows a champion for a few seconds (or shields an ally) — there is no ferry ability in his current kit, so the whole justification for giving him level 6 was invented. Replaced with the real gate: both his stun and his ultimate need three An Acquired Taste stacks. Also corrected the 'grey health he walks off' framing — Thick Skin can be activated on a 3-second cooldown to convert stored damage into a shield, which is what eats your Mega burst. wants.foe[2] still contains the roam claim; it needs the same fix and I flagged it rather than force a rewrite that would drift outside its band. Data note: brief header says 725 games, packet says 462.
